- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under **Unreleased** (skip for docs-only or CI-only changes)
- [ ] Any new test fixtures contain **no real personal data**: names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, ID numbers and employers are all fake
- [ ] Public API changes are reflected in `README.md` and `README.es.md`
